title: PiPi — Multi-Agent Chatbot at Bamnang
subtitle: A multilingual conversational AI bringing universities, scholarships, majors, and mentor information into one unified student experience.
description: PiPi bridges diverse education knowledge bases across Bamnang, allowing Cambodian students to discover opportunities naturally through conversation in English, Khmer, and Khmer Latin.
appPrompt: Experience PiPi firsthand by downloading and testing the Bamnang App.

images.title: Campus & Major Discovery
images.caption: Exploring universities, faculties, and admission details via conversation

images.title: Mentor Consultation
images.caption: Inquiring about mentors, guidance, and scheduled study sessions

images.title: Scholarship Search
images.caption: Discovering active scholarships, eligibility, and application deadlines

situation.title: The Situation
situation.subtitle: Scattered information and multilingual communication barriers
situation.description: Bamnang users need information about universities, majors, scholarships, campuses, events, and mentors. Information was spread across different areas, making it harder for users to get a clear answer through one conversation.
points: Bamnang users need information about universities, majors, scholarships, campuses, events, and mentors.
Users communicate in different ways: English, Khmer, and Khmer written in Latin letters.
Information was spread across different areas, making it harder for users to get a clear answer through one conversation.

task.title: The Task
task.subtitle: Unifying educational knowledge into an intuitive, multilingual conversational agent
task.description: Make PiPi capable of understanding and responding to users across English, Khmer, and Khmer Latin, while unifying knowledge from various areas into one conversational flow.
points: Make PiPi able to understand and respond to users across English, Khmer, and Khmer Latin.
Bring different types of Bamnang knowledge into one conversational experience.
Make the experience simple, natural, and useful for students, regardless of how they communicate.

action.title: The Action
action.subtitle: Knowledge integration, multilingual NLP handling, and user-centric testing
action.description: Engineered a structured knowledge workflow and conversational pipeline tailored to student user personas.
points: Organized and connected knowledge from various sources.
Designed the chatbot experience to handle English, Khmer, and Khmer Latin conversations.
Focused on making answers clear, relevant, and easy for students to understand.
Tested different user questions and conversation patterns to improve the quality and consistency of responses.
Considered the chatbot from the user's perspective, not only from the information it contains.

result.title: The Result
result.subtitle: Multilingual, accessible education discovery for students
result.description: PiPi now provides a multilingual, student-friendly way to discover Bamnang's education information through conversation, making the information easier to access and explore.
points: PiPi now provides a multilingual, student-friendly way to discover Bamnang's education information through conversation, making the information easier to access and explore.

title: Major-Recommendation at Bamnang (MCT)
subtitle: A guided assessment system connecting students' personal strengths, interests, and career preferences with matching university majors and job fields.
description: MCT bridges student self-discovery and higher education choices by converting user responses into actionable career clusters and major recommendations.
appPrompt: Experience the Major Career Test (MCT) firsthand by downloading and testing the Bamnang App.

images.title: Interactive Self-Discovery
images.caption: Guided questionnaire assessing student interests, skills, and personal strengths

images.title: Career Cluster Matching
images.caption: Connecting student characteristics with relevant professional fields and job pathways

images.title: Actionable Major Suggestions
images.caption: Clear breakdown of recommended university majors and curriculum directions

situation.title: The Situation
situation.subtitle: Unclear career pathways and limited self-awareness among students
situation.description: Students often know they want a future career, but may not know which major or career direction fits them. Choosing a major can be difficult when students have limited understanding of their interests, strengths, and possible career paths. Bamnang needed a way to help students explore suitable directions through a simple and guided experience.
points: Students often know they want a future career, but may not know which major or career direction fits them.
Choosing a major can be difficult when students have limited understanding of their interests, strengths, and possible career paths.
Bamnang needed a way to help students explore suitable directions through a simple and guided experience.

task.title: The Task
task.subtitle: Building an insightful, actionable recommendation system for career self-discovery
task.description: Build a user experience that helps students discover potential study and career directions, turning answers into meaningful recommendations rather than plain test scores.
points: Build a user experience that helps students discover potential study and career directions.
Turn students' answers into meaningful recommendations, rather than simply showing test scores.
Make the result understandable and useful for students when considering their next step.

action.title: The Action
action.subtitle: User-centric assessment design, job cluster mapping, and structured pathway insights
action.description: Designed the MCT experience around students' interests, characteristics, and career preferences, structuring the journey from self-discovery to university majors.
points: Designed the MCT experience around students' interests, characteristics, and career preferences.
Connected students' responses with relevant job clusters and career directions.
Developed a result experience that shows students their potential matches and why they may fit those directions.
Structured the results so students can move from self-understanding → career direction → possible majors.

result.title: The Result
result.subtitle: Actionable self-discovery bridging students to confident education decisions
result.description: Students receive a personalized view of career and study directions, creating a clear bridge between student self-discovery and education decisions.
points: Students receive a more personalized view of possible career and study directions.
Instead of only getting a score, students can understand what their result means and why certain directions may fit them.
MCT creates a bridge between student self-discovery and education decisions.
